content: Aristotle (384–322 BCE) was an ancient Greek philosopher and polymath, a student of Plato and tutor of Alexander the Great, whose writings on logic, metaphysics, ethics, politics, biology, and poetics laid the foundation for much of Western intellectual tradition.
